paragraphs: Epoch Solutions Group sells software to utilities that want to modernize how field work gets done. Its main platform, EpochField, is built for electric, gas, water, and telecom providers and gives field crews tools to inspect, maintain, and respond.

The platform is sold either on premise or as a hosted service, and covers creating, scheduling, and managing work while delivering data to the field in real time. The work it supports runs from vegetation management and leak surveys to pole inspections and storm restoration. The company has broadened beyond field crews into GIS data synchronization and Esri Utility Network migration.

Epoch Solutions Group was founded in 2006. It says it serves utilities across North America, Australia, New Zealand, and the UK. The about page claims over 30,000 users and 72 million customers served worldwide. The same page describes the company as an Esri Gold Partner with a Utility Network Management Specialty.

quote.text: Epoch Solutions Group is helping utilities modernize how field work gets done.
